彗孛彗星
Broom Stars and Comets
181
開寶八年六月甲子，出柳，長四丈，辰見東方，西南指，曆輿鬼至東壁，凡十一舍，八十三日而滅。
In the sixth month of the eighth year of the Kaibao era, on the day jiazi, a comet emerged in Willow, four zhang in length. It was seen at dawn in the east, pointing southwest, and passed through Chariot and Ghost to Eastern Wall—a total of eleven lodges—before vanishing after eighty-three days.
182
端拱二年七月戊子，又出東井積水西，青白色，光芒漸長，辰見東北，旬日夕見西北，曆右攝提，凡三十日至亢沒。
In the seventh month of the second year of the Duangong era, on the day wuzi, it again emerged west of the Accumulated Water of Eastern Well. It was bluish-white, its rays gradually lengthening. It was seen at dawn in the northeast; after ten days it was seen in the northwest at dusk. It passed through Right Arrayed Timbers and, in thirty days altogether, set in Kang.
183
咸平元年正月甲申，又出營室北，光芒尺餘，至丁酉，凡十四日滅。 六年十一月辛亥，旄頭犯輿鬼。 甲寅，有彗孛于井、鬼，大如杯，色青白，光芒四尺餘，曆五諸侯及五車入參，凡三十餘日沒。
In the first month of the first year of the Xianping era, on the day jiashen, it again emerged north of Encampment, its rays more than a foot long. By the day dingyou, after fourteen days in all, it vanished. In the eleventh month of the sixth year of the Xianping era, on the day xinhai, Mao Tou encroached upon Chariot and Ghost. On the day jiayin, a broom star appeared in Well and Ghost, as large as a cup and bluish-white in color, with rays more than four feet long. It passed through the Five Feudal Lords and Five Chariots and entered Shen, and after more than thirty days in all it set.
184
天禧二年六月辛亥，彗出北斗魁第二星東北，長三尺許，與北斗第一星齊，北行經天牢，拂文昌，長三尺餘，曆紫微、三台、軒轅速行而西，至七星，凡三十七日沒。
In the sixth month of the second year of the Tianxi era, on the day xinhai, a comet emerged northeast of the second star of the Dipper's Scepter, about three feet long and level with the Dipper's first star. Traveling north, it passed through Celestial Prison and brushed Literary Glory, its tail lengthening to more than three feet. It passed through Purple Palace, Three Steps, and Charioteer, moving rapidly west to Seven Stars, and set after thirty-seven days in all.
185
景祐元年八月壬戌夜，有星孛于張、翼，長七尺，闊五寸，十二日而沒。 十二月己未夜，有星出外屏，有芒氣。
On the night of the day renxu in the eighth month of the first year of the Jingyou era, a broom star appeared in Extended Net and Wings, seven feet long and five inches wide. After twelve days it set. In the twelfth month, on the night of the day jiwei, a star emerged from Outer Screen with rayed vapors.
186
皇祐元年二月丁卯，彗出虛，晨見東方，西南指，曆紫微至婁，凡一百一十四日而沒。
In the second month of the first year of the Huangyou era, on the day dingmao, a comet emerged in Emptiness. It was seen at dawn in the east, pointing southwest, and passed through Purple Palace to Lou—a total of one hundred fourteen days—before it set.
187
嘉祐元年七月，彗出紫微，曆七星，其色白，長丈餘，至八月癸亥滅。
In the seventh month of the first year of the Jiayou era, a comet emerged in Purple Palace and passed through Seven Stars. It was white in color and more than one zhang long, and by the day guihai in the eighth month it had vanished.
188
治平三年三月己未，彗出營室，晨見東方，長七尺許，西南指危洎墳墓，漸東速行，近日而伏。 至辛巳，夕見西南，北有星，無芒彗，益東方，別有白氣一，闊三尺許，貫紫微極星並房宿，首尾入濁，益東行，曆文昌、北斗貫尾。 至壬午，星復有芒彗，長丈餘，闊三尺餘，東北指，曆五車，白氣爲岐橫天，貫北河、五諸侯、軒轅、太微五帝坐內五諸侯及角、亢、氐、房宿。 癸未，彗長丈五尺，星有彗氣如一升器，曆營宿至張，凡一十四舍，積六十七日，星氣孛皆滅。
In the third month of the third year of the Zhiping era, on the day jiwei, a comet emerged in Encampment. Seen at dawn in the east, it was about seven feet long and pointed southwest toward Rooftop and Tomb and Graves. Moving gradually east with increasing speed, it drew near the sun and concealed itself. On the day xinsi it was seen in the southwest at dusk. To the north was a star with no cometary rays; farther east, a separate white vapor about three feet wide pierced Purple Palace's Pole Star and Room, both ends entering the turbid zone. Moving farther east, it passed through Literary Glory and pierced the tail of the Northern Dipper. On the day renwu the star again showed cometary rays, more than one zhang long and over three feet wide, pointing northeast. It passed through Five Chariots, while the white vapor forked across the sky, piercing Northern River, Five Feudal Lords, Charioteer, the Five Feudal Lords within the Five Emperors' Seat of Supreme Palace, and the lodges Horn, Neck, Base, and Room. On the day guiwei the comet was one zhang and five feet long, and the star's cometary vapor resembled a one-sheng measure. It passed from the Encampment lodge to Extended Net—a total of fourteen lodges over sixty-seven days—until the star's vapors and broom tail all vanished.
189
熙寧八年十月乙未，星出軫度中，如填，青白。 丙申，西北生光芒，長三尺，斜指軫，若彗。 丁酉，光芒長五尺。 戊戌，長七尺，斜指左轄，至丁未，入濁不見。
In the tenth month of the eighth year of the Xining era, on the day yiwei, a star emerged within the Chariot Shaft lodge-degree, resembling Saturn and bluish-white in color. On the day bingshen rays emerged in the northwest, three feet long and slanting toward Chariot Shaft, like a comet. On the day dingyou the rays were five feet long. On the day wuxu it was seven feet long and slanted toward Left Yoke. By the day dingwei it had entered the turbid zone and was no longer visible.
190
元豐三年七月癸未，彗出西北太微垣郎位南，白氣長一丈，斜指東南，在軫度中。 丙戌，向西北行，在翼度中。 戊子，長三尺，斜穿郎位。 癸卯，犯軒轅，至丁酉入濁不見。 庚子晨，復出於張度中。 至戊子，凡三十有六日，沒不見。
In the seventh month of the third year of the Yuanfeng era, on the day guiwei, a comet emerged south of the Gentleman-in-Waiting Seat in the northwest Supreme Palace Enclosure. Its white vapor was one zhang long, slanting toward the southeast within the Chariot Shaft lodge-degree. On the day bingxu it traveled northwest, within the Wings lodge-degree. On the day wuzi it was three feet long and obliquely pierced the Gentleman-in-Waiting Seat. On the day guimao it encroached upon Charioteer, and by the day dingyou it had entered the turbid zone and was no longer visible. On the morning of the day gengzi it reappeared within the Extended Net lodge-degree. By the day wuzi, after thirty-six days in all, it set and was no longer visible.
191
紹聖四年八月己酉，彗出氐度中，如填，有光，色白，氣長三丈，斜指天市左星，九月壬子，光芒長五尺，入天市垣。 己未，犯天市垣宦者。 庚申，犯天市垣帝坐。 戊辰，沒不見。
In the eighth month of the fourth year of the Shaosheng era, on the day jiyou, a comet emerged within the Base lodge-degree, resembling Saturn with a bright white glow and vapor three zhang long slanting toward the left star of Celestial Market. In the ninth month on the day renzi its rays were five feet long as it entered the Celestial Market Enclosure. On the day jiwei it encroached upon the Eunuch star of the Celestial Market Enclosure. On the day gengshen it encroached upon the Emperor's Seat of the Celestial Market Enclosure. On the day wuchen it set and was no longer visible.
192
崇寧五年正月戊戌，彗出西方，如杯口大，光芒散出如碎星，長六丈，闊三尺，斜指東北，自奎宿貫婁、胃、昴、畢，後入濁不見。
In the first month of the fifth year of the Chongning era, on the day wuxu, a comet emerged in the west as large as a cup mouth. Its rays scattered outward like broken stars, six zhang long and three feet wide, slanting northeast from the Legs lodge through Lou, Stomach, Hairy Head, and Net before entering the turbid zone and disappearing.
193
大觀四年五月丁未，彗出奎、婁，光芒長六尺，北行入紫微垣，至西北入濁不見。
In the fifth month of the fourth year of the Daguan era, on the day dingwei, a comet emerged in Legs and Lou with rays six feet long. Traveling north it entered the Purple Palace Enclosure and, reaching the northwest, entered the turbid zone and was no longer visible.
194
靖康元年六月壬戌，彗出紫微垣。
In the sixth month of the first year of the Jingkang era, on the day renxu, a comet emerged from the Purple Palace Enclosure.
195
紹興元年九月，彗星見。 十二月戊寅、二年八月甲寅，見於胃。 丙辰，行犯土司空，至九月甲戌始滅。 十五年四月戊寅，彗星見東方。 丙申，復見於參度。 五月丁巳，化爲客星，其色青白。 壬戌，留守張，至六月丁亥乃消。 十六年十一月庚寅，彗星見西南危宿。 二十六年七月丙午，彗星見東井，約長一丈，光芒二尺。 癸丑，又犯五諸侯。 三十一年六月己巳，彗星見北斗天權星東北，太史妄稱爲含譽。
In the ninth month of the first year of the Shaoxing era, a comet appeared. In the twelfth month on the day wuyin of the first year, and in the eighth month on the day jiayin of the second year, it was seen in Stomach. On the day bingchen, as it moved it encroached upon Earth Grand Marshal, and it did not vanish until the day jiaxu in the ninth month. In the fourth month of the fifteenth year of the Shaoxing era, on the day wuyin, a comet appeared in the east. On the day bingshen it reappeared within the Three Stars lodge-degree. In the fifth month on the day dingsi it transformed into a guest star, bluish-white in color. On the day renxu it remained at Extended Net, and it did not finally dissipate until the day dinghai in the sixth month. In the eleventh month of the sixteenth year of the Shaoxing era, on the day gengyin, a comet appeared southwest at Rooftop. In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of the Shaoxing era, on the day bingwu, a comet appeared at Eastern Well, about one zhang long with rays two feet long. On the day guichou it again encroached upon Five Feudal Lords. In the sixth month of the thirty-first year of the Shaoxing era, on the day jisi, a comet appeared northeast of the Northern Dipper's Balance star. The Grand Clerk wrongly identified it as Holding Glory.
196
淳熙二年七月辛丑，有星孛于西北方，當紫微垣外七公之上，小如熒惑，森然蓬孛，至丙午始消。
In the seventh month of the second year of the Chunxi era, on the day xinchou, a broom star appeared in the northwest above the Seven Lords outside the Purple Palace Enclosure. It was as small as Mars and bristled like a broom star, and it did not dissipate until the day bingwu.
197
嘉定十五年八月甲午，彗星見右攝提，光芒三尺餘，體類歲星，凡兩月，曆氐、房、心乃沒。
In the eighth month of the fifteenth year of the Jiading era, on the day jiawu, a comet appeared at Right Arrayed Timbers with rays more than three feet long and a body resembling Jupiter. Over two months it passed through Base, Room, and Heart and then set.
198
紹定三年十一月丁酉，有星孛於天市垣屠肆星之下，明年二月壬午乃消。 五年閏九月，彗星見東方，十月己未始消。
In the eleventh month of the third year of the Shaoding era, on the day dingyou, a broom star appeared below the Butcher's Shop star of the Celestial Market Enclosure. It did not finally dissipate until the day renwu in the second month of the following year. In the intercalary ninth month of the fifth year of the Shaoding era a comet appeared in the east, and it first dissipated on the day jiwei in the tenth month.
199
嘉熙四年正月辛未，彗星見於室，至三月辛未乃消。
In the first month of the fourth year of the Jiaxi era, on the day xinwei, a comet appeared in Encampment, and it did not finally dissipate until the day xinwei in the third month.
200
景定五年七月甲戌，彗星見於柳，芒角燭天，長十餘丈，日高方斂，凡月餘，己卯，退行，見於輿鬼。 辛巳，在井。 丙申，見於參。 戊戌，在參宿度內。 八月末，光芒稍減，凡四月乃滅。
In the seventh month of the fifth year of the Jingding era, on the day jiaxu, a comet appeared in Willow with rays and horns that lit the sky, more than ten zhang long, diminishing only when the sun stood high. After more than a month, on the day jimao it retrograded and appeared in Chariot and Ghost. On the day xinsi it was in Well. On the day bingshen it appeared in Three Stars. On the day wuxu it was within the Three Stars lodge-degree. At the end of the eighth month its rays diminished slightly, and after four months in all it vanished.
201
建隆二年十二月己酉，出天市垣宗人星東，微有芒彗，三年正月辛未，西南行入氐宿，二月癸丑，至七星沒。
In the twelfth month of the second year of the Jianlong era, on the day jiyou, it emerged east of the Clan Person star of the Celestial Market Enclosure with a faint cometary tail. In the first month of the third year on the day xinwei it traveled southwest into Base, and on the day guichou in the second month it set at Seven Stars.
202
太平興國八年二月甲辰，出太微垣端門東，近屏星，北行。
In the second month of the eighth year of the Taiping Xingguo era, on the day jiachen, it emerged east of the End Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure, near Screen Star, and traveled north.
203
端拱二年七月丁亥，出北河星西北，稍暗，微有芒彗，指西南。
In the seventh month of the second year of the Duangong era, on the day dinghai, it emerged northwest of the Northern River star, somewhat dim with a faint cometary tail, pointing southwest.
204
淳化元年正月辛巳，出軫宿，逆至張，七十日，經四十度乃不見。
In the first month of the first year of the Chunhua era, on the day xinsi, it emerged at Chariot Shaft. Retrograding to Extended Net, over seventy days and forty degrees, it was no longer visible.
205
景德二年八月甲辰，出紫微天棓側，孛孛然如粉絮，稍入垣內，曆御女、華蓋，凡十一日沒。 三年三月乙巳，出東南方。
In the eighth month of the second year of the Jingde era, on the day jiachen, it emerged beside Purple Palace's Celestial Flail, bristling like powdered fluff. It entered slightly within the enclosure, passed through Serving Maid and Canopy, and set after eleven days in all. In the third month of the third year of the Jingde era, on the day yisi, it emerged in the southeast.
206
大中祥符四年正月丁丑，見南斗魁前。
In the first month of the fourth year of the Dazhong Xiangfu era, on the day dingchou, it appeared before the Scepter of the Southern Dipper.
207
天禧五年四月丙辰，出軒轅前星西北，大如桃，速行，經軒轅大星入太微垣，掩右執法，犯次將，曆屏星西北，凡七十五日，入濁沒。
In the fourth month of the fifth year of the Tianxi era, on the day bingchen, it emerged northwest of Charioteer's Front Star, as large as a peach and moving rapidly. Passing Charioteer's great star it entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, obscuring the Right Administrator of Law and encroaching upon the Second General, then passed northwest of Screen Star. After seventy-five days in all it entered the turbid zone and set.
208
明道元年六月乙巳，出東北方，近濁，有芒彗。 至丁巳，凡十三日沒。
In the sixth month of the first year of the Mingdao era, on the day yisi, it emerged in the northeast near the turbid zone with a cometary tail. By the day dingsi, after thirteen days in all, it set.
209
至和元年五月己丑，出天關東南，可數寸，歲餘稍沒。
In the fifth month of the first year of the Zhihe era, on the day jichou, it emerged southeast of Celestial Pass, several inches across. After more than a year it gradually set.
210
熙寧二年六月丙辰，出箕度中，至七月丁卯，犯箕乃散。 三年十一月丁未，出天囷。
In the sixth month of the second year of the Xining era, on the day bingchen, it emerged within the Winnowing Basket lodge-degree. By the day dingmao in the seventh month, after encroaching upon Winnowing Basket, it scattered. In the eleventh month of the third year of the Xining era, on the day dingwei, it emerged at Celestial Granary.
211
元祐六年十一月辛亥，出參度中，犯、掩廁星，壬子，犯九遊星，十二月癸酉，入奎，至七年三月辛亥乃散。
In the eleventh month of the sixth year of the Yuanyou era, on the day xinhai, it emerged within the Three Stars lodge-degree, encroaching upon and obscuring Privy Star. On the day renzi it encroached upon Nine Tours Star; in the twelfth month on the day guiyou it entered Legs, and it did not finally scatter until the day xinhai in the third month of the seventh year.
212
紹興八年五月，守婁，魯分也。 九年二月壬申，守亢，陳分也。
In the fifth month of the eighth year of the Shaoxing era it remained at Lou, the allotted region of Lu. In the second month of the ninth year of the Shaoxing era, on the day renshen it remained at Neck, the allotted region of Chen.
213
乾道二年三月癸酉，出太微垣內五帝坐大星西，微小，色青白。
In the third month of the second year of the Qiandao era, on the day guiyou, it emerged west of the great star of the Five Emperors' Seat within the Supreme Palace Enclosure, very small and bluish-white in color.
214
淳熙八年六月己巳，出奎宿，犯傳舍星，至明年正月癸酉，凡一百八十五日始滅。
In the sixth month of the eighth year of the Chunxi era, on the day jisi, it emerged at the Legs lodge and encroached upon Relay Inn star. It did not finally vanish until the day guiyou in the first month of the following year, one hundred eighty-five days in all.
215
嘉泰三年六月乙卯，出東南尾宿間，色青白，大如填星。 甲子，守尾。
In the sixth month of the third year of the Jiatai era, on the day yimao, it emerged between the Tail lodges in the southeast, bluish-white in color and as large as Saturn. On the day jiazi it remained at Tail.
216
嘉定十七年六月己丑，犯尾宿。
In the sixth month of the seventeenth year of the Jiading era, on the day jichou, it encroached upon the Tail lodge.
217
嘉熙四年七月庚寅，出尾宿。
In the seventh month of the fourth year of the Jiaxi era, on the day gengyin, it emerged at the Tail lodge.
